sky: Neutral diffuse dome; direct sky visibility and six-bounce diffuse transport; no directional sun baked

surfaceProfiles.interiorShaftFinish: Bounded 0.30–0.48 response interpreted from primary photographs; no measured polish/roughness specification

diffuseEncoding: Cycles outgoing unit-albedo radiance; Linear Rec.709 source → Standard/sRGB PNG → lossless WebP. Decode sRGB and multiply by pi times radianceScale for Three.js Lambert irradiance.
retainedHdrTransfer: linear; separate Non-Color float buffer set before pixel assignment

arcadeNormalIntegrity.scope: arcade-enclosure imported authored normals retained without topology or normal operations

authoredUvIntegrity.scope: Post-import buffers including geometry, every UV, normals, material indices, smoothing, matrices and render/viewport visibility. Source GLB byte preservation is proven separately.

occlusionBindingIntegrity.method: Reuse/update every recognized Occlusion settings input; create only when absent

occluderMaterialIntegrity.scope: Established library applied only to actual imported neighbour objects/material pointers; primary meshes/materials excluded
